reason: Regressions from harness, system-prompt and config changes recur. Claude Code v2.1.251 (2026-08-28) silently changed CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL from an override to a default. RMD-K02-001 also records, as of 2026-09-28, two independent but vendor-unconfirmed reports of an Opus 4.6 behavior change under the same model ID. These are consistent with the variability mechanism but are not treated as fact. Remedies RMD-K02-001 (run manifest plus canary eval), RMD-K03-001 (validated, one axis changed per release with ablation) and RMD-K03-002 (official PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch hooks, explicit model pin) are current. No evidence of resolution.
